body: Sharan Bansal (Director / ED) on 2025-11-07 (Q2FY26 concall transcript): "Long term, we do aspire that our margins should move from the current 10%, 10.5% level to 12% level in the longer term." Metric: Consolidated EBITDA margin. Target: ~12%. Deadline: long term (unstated). Specificity: vague; prompted by analyst. Status as of 2026-11-19: pending. Evidence: No date. H1FY27 ~10.6%.
